explainer_content.short_definition: Salsa, tropical dance, and Latin pop crossover where clave, horns, percussion, and vocal command drive the room.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Celia Cruz, Fania-era salsa, and later bachata/tropical crossover show a dance tradition that can be local, diasporic, and pop-facing at once.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It explains how Latin dance music becomes social memory: the arrangement tells bodies where to move.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: Compared with reggaeton, the pulse is more clave/percussion/horn driven than dembow-programmed.
